meta.name: atlassian-admin
meta.description: Atlassian Administrator for managing and organizing Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Trello), users, permissions, security, integrations, system configuration, and org-wide governance. Use when asked to add users to Jira, change Confluence permissions, configure access control, update admin settings, manage Atlassian groups, set up SSO, install marketplace apps, review security policies, or handle any org-wide Atlassian administration task.

copy.tagline: 管理 Atlassian 产品、用户、权限与安全配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Jira、Confluence 等 Atlassian 产品的组织级设置
copy.tagline_en: Manage Atlassian products, users, permissions, and security settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage org-wide settings for Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian products

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 Atlassian 产品（Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket、Trello），包括添加用户、设置权限、配置 SSO、安装应用、优化系统性能等。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 Atlassian 用户、权限、安全设置或系统配置时触发，例如添加用户到 Jira、更改 Confluence 权限或设置 SSO。

say.text: 帮我给新员工张三创建 Jira 账号并加入开发组。
say.note: Claude 会执行用户创建和分组操作。

say.text: 为 Confluence 空间设置仅管理员可编辑的权限。
say.note: Claude 会修改空间权限方案。

say.text: 配置 Azure AD 作为 SSO 身份提供商。
say.note: Claude 会引导完成 SAML 配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Trello), including adding users, setting permissions, configuring SSO, installing apps, and optimizing system performance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Atlassian users, permissions, security settings, or system configuration, e.g., add users to Jira, change Confluence permissions, or set up SSO.

say_en.text: Create a Jira account for new employee Zhang San and add to the dev group.
say_en.note: Claude will perform user creation and group assignment.

say_en.text: Set Confluence space permissions to admin-only edit.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the space permission scheme.

say_en.text: Configure Azure AD as the SSO identity provider.
say_en.note: Claude will guide through SAML configuration.
